reuse.why: Uses the shared recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and applyWeekendRule (the same weekend rule getNextDate and getUpcomingDates use) plus month utilities, rather than re-deriving weekend handling.

duplication.why: The RSchedule construction and try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper mirror getUpcomingDates, a small structural repeat; the weekend decision itself is not duplicated.

placement.why: Handler sits next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered like it; the range logic could arguably live in shared/schedules.ts but this matches the sibling handler.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration/type and tests.

maintainability.why: Short, commented (shift window constant) and built on the shared weekend rule; the window constant is local knowledge of applyWeekendRule's maximum shift.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated decision logic; only the handler boilerplate resembles getUpcomingDates.
